vb_textbox.text: Of the two gnomes shown, pick one and remember the number of mushrooms given. If this is a high number, keep choosing that gnome until the number gradually gets lower. If it is a low number, try choosing the other gnome the next time this selection of two appears. The general rule of thumb seems to be one gnome will offer a higher amount but this number will decline over time, at which point you should choose the other colour of gnome. The positions of the gnomes on screen seem to have no effect on the number of mushrooms given.
